summary: Recent updates to the testing framework for Firefox have focused on improving the audio experience and ensuring more robust functionality. One notable change ensures that the system clock is kept stable until the audio stream catches up after a seek, which helps maintain audio quality and synchronicity during playback. Additionally, fixes have been made to correct minor coding errors, like an off-by-one error in the AudioConfig settings, which ensures more reliable configurations. Lastly, new tests have been added to check the duration handling of the ADTSTrackDemuxer, which is crucial for accurately processing audio streams with a large number of frames. These enhancements contribute to a more reliable and seamless media playback experience for users.
